title: Grok 4 Fast Model Card
paper_type_zh: 闭源前沿模型卡与数据披露台账
best_for_zh: 审计和比较闭源前沿模型的后训练、工具使用、安全与披露边界的读者
one_line: Grok 4 Fast's model card and launch announcement disclose broad pretraining sources, de-duplication/classification, SFT and RL with human feedback, verifiable rewards and model grading, safety mitigations, and tool-use RL, but not record-level data, reward, filter, or evaluator contracts.
Grok 4 Fast 的模型卡和发布公告披露了宽泛的预训练来源、去重/分类、SFT、使用人类反馈/可验证奖励/模型评分的 RL、安全缓解措施及工具使用 RL，但未披露记录级数据、奖励、过滤器或评估器合约。
why: It provides a closed-frontier disclosure baseline for separating report-level evidence about post-training, safety, tool use, and test-time behavior from missing provenance, data-rights, verifier, evaluation, and reproducibility evidence.
inclusion_reason: A 2025 xAI model card and launch announcement that disclose broad pretraining-source categories, de-duplication/classification, SFT/RL feedback families, safety mitigations, end-to-end tool-use RL, and selected evaluation procedures, while leaving the underlying records and most recipe controls undisclosed.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Frontier model reports can describe post-training, safety, and product behavior at a high level without exposing the data and feedback contracts needed to audit those claims. This Card therefore asks what xAI's official sources disclose for Grok 4 Fast and what they leave unestablished; it does not treat the report as a reusable training recipe.

The Grok 4 Fast Model Card names broad data-source categories, filtering, supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement-learning feedback families, safety mitigations, and selected evaluations. The official launch announcement adds large-scale RL, end-to-end tool-use RL, unified reasoning/non-reasoning weights, and product-level test-time-compute claims. Neither source releases record-level provenance, data manifests, rewards, graders, filters, or a full reproducibility package.

前沿模型报告可以在高层描述后训练、安全和产品行为，却不公开审计这些主张所需的数据与反馈合约。因此，本 Card 要回答的是 xAI 官方材料对 Grok 4 Fast 披露了什么、尚未证实什么；它不把该报告当作可复用的训练配方。

Grok 4 Fast Model Card列出宽泛的数据来源类别、过滤、监督微调、强化学习反馈类别、安全缓解措施和部分评估；官方发布公告补充了大规模 RL、端到端工具使用 RL、统一的推理/非推理权重以及产品层的测试时计算主张。两份来源均未发布记录级溯源、数据清单、奖励、评分器、过滤器或完整复现包。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
This Card treats Grok 4 Fast as a partial disclosure ledger. The model card says that its pretraining recipe includes publicly available Internet data, third-party data produced for xAI, data from users or contractors, and internally generated data. It also says that data are de-duplicated and classified before training, and that the recipe uses supervised fine-tuning of specific capabilities plus reinforcement-learning techniques involving human feedback, verifiable rewards, and model grading (model card, §3.1).

The data object is therefore a report-level description of a closed training and evaluation pipeline, not a released corpus. The card additionally says the model was post-trained on tasks, tool use, and demonstrations of correct refusals. However, the sources do not disclose the actual prompts, demonstrations, traces, tool trajectories, reward records, or the definitions of the feedback signals used in post-training.

本 Card 将 Grok 4 Fast 视为一份部分披露台账。模型卡称，其预训练配方包括公开互联网数据、第三方为 xAI 生产的数据、用户或承包商数据以及内部生成数据；还称在训练前进行去重和分类，并对特定能力进行监督微调，同时使用涉及人类反馈、可验证奖励和模型评分的强化学习技术（模型卡第 3.1 节）。

因此，数据对象是对封闭训练与评估管线的报告级描述，而不是已发布语料。模型卡还称该模型在任务、工具使用和正确拒答示例上进行了后训练；但来源未披露实际提示词、示例、轨迹、工具轨迹、奖励记录，或后训练所用反馈信号的定义。

title: Method
方法
html:
The disclosed method has four bounded layers.

  1. Data and filtering. The model card lists four broad pretraining-source categories and says xAI applies de-duplication and classification for quality and safety. It does not give proportions, source manifests, prompt provenance, classifier definitions, thresholds, yields, rejected-item policy, or benchmark-overlap checks.
  2. Post-training. The card names supervised fine-tuning, human feedback, verifiable rewards, and model grading. The launch announcement says xAI used large-scale RL to increase intelligence density and trained the model end-to-end with tool-use RL. Objectives, reward definitions, graders, rollout policy, sampling, schedules, and data counts are undisclosed.
  3. Safety measures and evaluation. The card says an injected safety-policy system-level instruction and model-based input filters are deployed. It reports refusal, AgentHarm, AgentDojo, MASK, answer-sycophancy, internal soft-bias, WMDP, VCT, BioLP-Bench, CyBench, and MakeMeSay evaluations. The soft-bias evaluation uses an LLM judge; CyBench uses an agent harness with code execution and the Inspect evaluation framework.
  4. Product/inference surface. The announcement says reasoning and non-reasoning behavior use the same weights and are steered with system-level instructions. It names 2M-token context windows and configurable test-time compute for API users, not a reproducible training or evaluation sampling budget.

已披露的方法可分为四个边界明确的层次。

  1. 数据与过滤。 模型卡列出四类宽泛预训练来源，并称 xAI 为质量和安全采用去重与分类；但未给出比例、来源清单、提示词溯源、分类器定义、阈值、产出量、拒绝样本策略或基准重叠检查。
  2. 后训练。 模型卡列出监督微调、人类反馈、可验证奖励和模型评分。发布公告称，xAI 使用大规模 RL 提升智能密度，并端到端地训练工具使用 RL；但目标函数、奖励定义、评分器、rollout 策略、采样、日程和数据量均未披露。
  3. 安全措施与评估。 模型卡称部署了注入式安全策略系统提示词和基于模型的输入过滤器，并报告拒答、AgentHarm、AgentDojo、MASK、answer-sycophancy、内部 soft-bias、WMDP、VCT、BioLP-Bench、CyBench 和 MakeMeSay 评估。soft-bias 评估使用 LLM 裁判；CyBench 使用带代码执行能力的智能体 harness 与 Inspect 评估框架。
  4. 产品/推理层。 公告称推理与非推理行为使用相同权重，并由系统提示词引导；它给出 200 万 token 上下文和供 API 用户配置的测试时计算，而不是可复现的训练或评估采样预算。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The primary source is a seven-page official xAI model card last updated on 2025-09-19. It directly supports the broad source-category, filtering, SFT/RL-feedback, safety-mitigation, and evaluation statements in this Card. The official launch announcement independently supports large-scale RL, end-to-end tool-use RL, unified reasoning/non-reasoning weights, 2M-token context, and the stated product behavior.

Table 1 reports, for reasoning/non-reasoning respectively, refusal answer rates of 0.00/0.00, user-jailbreak answer rates of 0.00/0.00, system-jailbreak answer rates of 0.00/0.01, AgentHarm answer rates of 0.08/0.10, and AgentDojo attack-success rates of 0.00/0.03. Table 2 reports MASK dishonesty rates of 0.47/0.63, internal soft-bias averages of 0.79/0.89, and sycophancy rates of 0.10/0.13. Table 3 reports a MakeMeSay win rate of 0.12, BioLP-Bench accuracy of 39.0, VCT accuracy of 54.5, WMDP Bio/Chem/Cyber accuracies of 85.2/77.5/81.4, and CyBench unguided success of 30.0.

These are source-reported, configuration-specific evaluation results. They are not evidence of released training data, a calibrated reward model, an independently reproducible deployment, or a general safety guarantee.

主要来源是一份由 xAI 发布、最后更新于 2025-09-19 的七页官方模型卡。它直接支持本 Card 中关于宽泛来源类别、过滤、SFT/RL 反馈、安全缓解和评估的表述。官方发布公告独立支持大规模 RL、端到端工具使用 RL、统一推理/非推理权重、200 万 token 上下文以及所述产品行为。

表 1 对推理/非推理模式分别报告：拒答 answer rate 为 0.00/0.00，用户越狱 answer rate 为 0.00/0.00，系统越狱 answer rate 为 0.00/0.01，AgentHarm answer rate 为 0.08/0.10，AgentDojo attack-success rate 为 0.00/0.03。表 2 报告 MASK dishonesty rate 为 0.47/0.63、内部 soft-bias 平均值为 0.79/0.89、sycophancy rate 为 0.10/0.13。表 3 报告 MakeMeSay win rate 为 0.12、BioLP-Bench accuracy 为 39.0、VCT accuracy 为 54.5、WMDP Bio/Chem/Cyber accuracy 为 85.2/77.5/81.4、CyBench unguided success 为 30.0。

这些是来源报告的、特定配置下的评估结果，并不是已发布训练数据、经过校准的奖励模型、可独立复现的部署或一般安全保证的证据。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
For this atlas, the contribution is not an open data, weight, reward, or code release. Its Track 12 value is the combination of a model-card disclosure of source categories, filtering, SFT/RL feedback families, safety mitigations, and evaluations with a launch disclosure of large-scale RL, tool-use RL, and reasoning-efficiency behavior.

That combination permits a disciplined ledger. Some pipeline components are named, but the source mixture, record lineage, verifier/reward contract, filter specification, training scaffold, and reproducibility artifacts remain undisclosed. The Card preserves that boundary instead of upgrading product or performance claims into a reusable recipe.

对本 atlas 而言，其贡献并非开放数据、权重、奖励或代码发布。它对 Track 12 的价值在于：模型卡披露了来源类别、过滤、SFT/RL 反馈类别、安全缓解措施和评估；发布公告披露了大规模 RL、工具使用 RL 及推理效率行为。

这一组合允许建立严谨台账：一些管线组件被命名，但来源混合、记录谱系、验证器/奖励合约、过滤器规格、训练脚手架和复现工件仍未披露。本 Card 保留这一边界，而不把产品或性能主张升级为可复用配方。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• The four source categories do not provide source proportions, manifests, rights/consent, retention, prompt provenance, data revisions, or item-level lineage.
  • The named human feedback, verifiable rewards, and model grading do not disclose reward/verifier definitions, grader identity/version, data, calibration, thresholds, coverage, error rates, or optimization weights.
  • De-duplication and classification are named without procedures, thresholds, efficacy, rejected-item policy, or benchmark-contamination/overlap evidence.
  • Internal soft-bias evaluation and its LLM judge are not released with paired prompts, judge prompts/versions, labels, calibration, or logs.
  • The injected system-level instruction and model-based filters are reported without a reproducible deployed prompt, filter version, threshold, coverage, or error analysis. No official code, data, weights, rollout records, or end-to-end reproducibility package was established from the two sources checked.

• 四类来源没有提供来源比例、清单、权利/同意、保留期限、提示词溯源、数据版本或记录级谱系。
  • 所称的人类反馈、可验证奖励和模型评分没有披露奖励/验证器定义、评分器身份/版本、数据、校准、阈值、覆盖范围、错误率或优化权重。
  • 去重与分类被提及，但没有程序、阈值、效果、拒绝样本策略或基准污染/重叠证据。
  • 内部 soft-bias 评估及其 LLM 裁判没有连同配对提示词、裁判提示词/版本、标签、校准或日志一同发布。
  • 注入式系统提示词和基于模型的过滤器虽被报告，但没有可复现的部署提示词、过滤器版本、阈值、覆盖范围或错误分析。针对已检查的两份来源，未能确立官方代码、数据、权重、rollout 记录或端到端复现包。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Use this Card to audit the boundary between an official frontier disclosure and a reusable post-training artifact. It establishes source-backed anchors for four questions: which source classes are named; which high-level feedback families are named; which safety/product/evaluation mechanisms are reported; and which data, verifier, filter, and reproducibility details remain unknown.

It can support comparison across Track 12 reports without treating shared terms such as “verifiable rewards,” “model grading,” “tool-use RL,” or “test-time compute” as evidence that their underlying data objects or feedback contracts are comparable. It is suitable for disclosure analysis and interpretation of reported safety/evaluation evidence, not direct training-data reuse or recipe replication.

使用本 Card 可审计“官方前沿披露”与“可复用后训练工件”之间的边界。它为四个问题提供来源支撑的锚点：命名了哪些来源类别；命名了哪些高层反馈类别；报告了哪些安全/产品/评估机制；以及哪些数据、验证器、过滤器和复现细节仍为 unknown。

它可支持 Track 12 报告之间的比较，但不应把“可验证奖励”“模型评分”“工具使用 RL”或“测试时计算”等共同术语，当作其底层数据对象或反馈合约可比的证据。它适合做披露分析与已报告安全/评估证据的解读，不适合直接复用训练数据或复刻配方。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read §3.1 first: it contains the bounded source, filtering, SFT, and RL disclosure that motivates this Card.
  • Keep safety-evaluation records separate from training evidence; a named benchmark or reported score does not disclose post-training data or its reward contract.
  • Read the launch announcement alongside the model card for large-scale RL, end-to-end tool-use RL, shared reasoning/non-reasoning weights, and product-level test-time-compute claims; leave unreported source partitions, task data, verifier coverage, and rollout details as unknown.
  • Treat Tables 1–3 as configuration-specific reported outcomes, not as release, reproducibility, or general-safety evidence.

• 先读第 3.1 节：其中包含本 Card 所依据的、边界明确的来源、过滤、SFT 和 RL 披露。
  • 将安全评估记录与训练证据分开；被命名的基准或被报告的分数，并不披露后训练数据或其奖励合约。
  • 将发布公告与模型卡一同阅读，以核验大规模 RL、端到端工具使用 RL、共享的推理/非推理权重和产品层测试时计算主张；未报告的来源分区、任务数据、验证器覆盖和 rollout 细节应标为 unknown。
  • 将表 1–3 视为特定配置下报告的结果，而不是发布、复现或一般安全性的证据。
